column1: # mapping_set_title: 'BSI TR-03183-2 SBOM Information Requirements v2.1.0 <-> SPDX 3.0.1'

# mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 20 data-field concepts defined in BSI Technical Guideline TR-03183-2 v2.1.0 (2025-08-20) to classes and properties in the SPDX 3.0.1 specification. Provision types (REQUIRED, CONDITIONAL, OPTIONAL) are recorded in bsi2025.ttl via bom:provisionType; this file focuses on semantic alignment and gap analysis. The bridge_concept column cites the neutral bridge concept from bom.ttl. GAP comments mark BSI fields with no equivalent in SPDX 3.0.1. Derived from the SPDX 3.1-dev mapping (tools/derive_spdx30.py): SPDX 3.1 is backward compatible with 3.0, so every target that exists in 3.0.1 is mapped the same way; targets added in 3.1 (Core/version, Core/intendedUse, isoAutomationLevel, byteSize, finetunedOn / pretrainedOn / validatedOn / evaluatedOn, conformsTo / Specification, SupportRelationship, ContactPointRelationship, InteractionTemplate, the Hardware profile) are replaced by the closest 3.0.1 carrier or recorded as GAP rows.'

column8: comment

BSI REQUIRED. CreationInfo.createdBy captures the agent(s) -- Agent (Person or Organization; tools go in createdUsing) -- that created the document. BSI requires an email address or URL; SPDX Agent carries contact info via Agent.externalIdentifier. Exact semantic match.

BSI REQUIRED. CreationInfo.created is a mandatory Core/DateTime (UTC, second resolution) recording when the document was compiled. BSI specifies UTC; SPDX strongly recommends UTC. Exact semantic match.

BSI CONDITIONAL (if it exists). The spdxId of the Sbom element serves as its persistent IRI. closeMatch because in SPDX 3.x every element always has a mandatory spdxId, whereas BSI's BOM-URI is optional (required only if a URI has been assigned to the document).

BSI REQUIRED. BSI 'creator' is the entity that authored and maintains the component (developer/author role). Artifact.originatedBy (-> Agent) captures the original creator; Artifact.suppliedBy covers the distributor. exactMatch because BSI creator = originatedBy; note: BSI requires an email address, available via Agent.externalIdentifier (type: email).

BSI REQUIRED. suppliedBy covers the distribution/provision role of a supplier; relatedMatch when the BSI component creator is also the party supplying the component rather than the original developer.

BSI REQUIRED. Element.name on a Software.Package element carries the component name. BSI note: if the component has no assigned name, the filename MUST be used -- same field in SPDX. Exact semantic match.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1) carries the component version string. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)

BSI REQUIRED. GAP: SPDX 3.x removed the SPDX 2.x PackageFileName field. The filename of the deployed component must be represented by creating a software_File element (with Element.name = the filename) linked to the Package via a Relationship of type hasDistributionArtifact. This is an indirect two-hop mapping; no single Package-level filename property exists in SPDX 3.0.1 or 3.1-dev. closeMatch to spdx3-core:name on spdx3-sw:File.
A Relationship with relationshipType hasDistributionArtifact from the Package to the File element whose name is the deployed filename. relatedMatch.

BSI REQUIRED. Dependency relationships (DEPENDS_ON, CONTAINS) are expressed as Relationship elements. BSI explicitly requires a completeness indication; SPDX 3.0.1 Relationship.completeness (vocabulary: complete, incomplete, noAssertion, unknown) covers this requirement. closeMatch because the set of Relationship elements plus their completeness annotation satisfies BSI fully.

BSI REQUIRED. Relationship.completeness explicitly records whether the dependency list is complete. BSI mandates this indication; SPDX 3.0.1 has this field natively. Exact semantic match for the completeness sub-requirement.

BSI REQUIRED. Relationship with relationshipType dependsOn from the dependent component to its dependencies (contains for the inclusion reading). exactMatch. The model requires a LifecycleScopedRelationship for this type (scope: LifecycleScopeType).

BSI REQUIRED. The concluded / distribution licence is a Relationship with relationshipType hasConcludedLicense from the artifact to a LicenseExpression. Exact match (bridge concept bom:component-concluded-license).

column2: Hash value of the deployable component
column8: BSI REQUIRED. BSI mandates a SHA-512 hash of the deployed component. Artifact.verifiedUsing (-> Hash) carries the digest. The Hash.algorithm field should be set to HashAlgorithm.sha512; Hash.hashValue carries the hex digest. closeMatch because the BSI SHA-512 constraint is narrower than SPDX's open algorithm vocabulary.

column2: Hash value of the deployable component
column8: BSI REQUIRED. Hash.algorithm within verifiedUsing identifies the hash algorithm. BSI mandates SHA-512 specifically; SPDX HashAlgorithm vocabulary includes sha512. narrowMatch (the algorithm aspect) -- SPDX supports the required algorithm but does not mandate it.

column2: Hash value of the deployable component
column8: BSI REQUIRED. Hash.algorithm = sha512: BSI TR-03183-2 mandates SHA-512 for the deployable form. exactMatch.

column2: Hash value of the deployable component
column8: BSI REQUIRED. Hash.hashValue (1..1) within verifiedUsing is the SHA-512 digest. narrowMatch (the digest aspect).
SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = executable (SoftwarePurpose). exactMatch.
SoftwareArtifact.primaryPurpose = archive (SoftwarePurpose). exactMatch.
primaryPurpose = container for a container image that bundles sub-components. closeMatch.

GAP (missing field): no structured-archive flag. primaryPurpose = archive is a structured archive whose internal component metadata is recoverable, as opposed to firmware or executable blobs. closeMatch.
GAP (missing field): primaryPurpose = container (image) is likewise a structured archive. closeMatch.

ExternalRef with externalRefType vcs (locator = repository URL, optionally with a tag or commit) points to the source repository; SoftwareArtifact.downloadLocation / sourceInfo complement it. closeMatch.

column2: URI of the deployable form of the component
column8: BSI CONDITIONAL (if it exists). SoftwareArtifact.downloadLocation (0..1, anyURI) is the URI from which the deployable form can be obtained. closeMatch.

column2: URI of the deployable form of the component
column8: ExternalRef with externalRefType altDownloadLocation carries further download locations of the deployable form. closeMatch.
BSI CONDITIONAL (if they exist). BSI cites CPE, SWID, PURL as examples. For PURL: Software.Package.packageUrl is an exact match (dedicated PURL field). Exact match for the PURL case.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).

BSI CONDITIONAL. The licence assigned by the creator is a Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense from the artifact to a LicenseExpression. Exact match (bridge concept bom:component-declared-license).
BSI OPTIONAL. The licence under which the SBOM creator actually uses the component is closest to a hasConcludedLicense Relationship concluded by that creator. relatedMatch.

column2: Hash value of the source code of the component
column8: BSI OPTIONAL. A hash of the source code (algorithm not yet standardised in TR-03183-2). In SPDX 3.x, the source code is represented as a software_File element (or a Package element for the source package); its verifiedUsing (-> Hash) carries the source hash. closeMatch -- the mapping is correct but requires attaching the hash to the source artifact element, not to the deployed Package element.
ExternalRef with externalRefType securityPolicy links the vulnerability-disclosure policy or security.txt (locator = URL). closeMatch.
